addr: 28, 80 Feet Rd, S.T. Bed, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: We visited Big bean cafe located in Koramangala recently for an art workshop. The ambience is lovely with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The cafe is pretty big with 3 floors, wide seating capacity, scenic views, decorative walls, theme …
Stumbled upon this cafe while meeting up with a friend in Koramangala. Was surprised to see the size and ambiance of the cafe, as from outside it doesn’t reflects it’s true scale. …
Best place in koramangala to have some coffee and watch stand up comedy ! they host mics and shows every Friday and Sunday 7:30pm. how do i know? i am one of the comics. Drop in! check us out.
